nodes.text:
P.S.

The toxicity of human metapneumovirus fever is the same as influenza, but if you rest, it will go away in 3 to 6 days. However, since you have been wearing a mask for 4 years, your resistance has been weakened, so if it lasts more than 5 to 6 days, go to the hospital.
